label: TP
reason: User input from the Referer header flows directly into response.getWriter().format() as the format string argument. Although URL decoding occurs and a minimal replace operation attempts to alter the last character, these controls do not neutralize format specifiers (e.g., %s, %%), enabling a format string vulnerability.

evidence.note: Unsanitized user input from Referer header used as format string in writer.format()
